subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: If exact live API evidence proves Google Chat app-auth direct-message thread replies are supported, should the feature also isolate OpenClaw sessions by thread rather than sharing the existing direct-message session?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96843 encode different conversation-memory semantics and durable option names; source inspection cannot select the intended product contract.

options.title: Unify delivery and sessions
options.body: Use one opt-in setting only if it both keeps replies in the originating thread and creates thread-specific OpenClaw sessions.

options.title: Allow shared-session threads
options.body: Permit transport-only threading and explicitly document that separate visible threads share one OpenClaw conversation context.

options.title: Keep threading unsupported
options.body: Retain the current unthreaded behavior if exact API evidence cannot overcome the published restriction.

recommendation.title: Unify delivery and sessions
recommendation.body: Use one opt-in setting only if it both keeps replies in the originating thread and creates thread-specific OpenClaw sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the Google Chat sender and previously landed thread-reply behavior in this area.
